title: Inspiration of Scripture
definition: The inspiration of Scripture means that God worked through human authors so that the writings they produced are truly God's Word.
summary: The Bible was written by real people living in real places and times, yet God guided them through the Holy Spirit. Scripture is therefore both fully human in its writing and fully divine in its origin.
christFocus: The inspired Scriptures reveal Jesus Christ from Genesis to Revelation. God's purpose in giving His Word is to make Christ known and to lead people to salvation through Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture did not originate from human imagination. God spoke through chosen authors so that His truth would be faithfully recorded for His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: If Scripture comes from God, then it can be trusted. Believers can approach the Bible with confidence that they are hearing God's truth rather than merely human ideas.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach Scripture prayerfully and reverently. Ask the Holy Spirit to help you understand and obey what God has revealed.
